name: Turkmenistan
shortSummary: India-Turkmenistan ties centre on long-discussed energy connectivity, notably the long-stalled TAPI (Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India) gas pipeline project.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: A long-planned gas pipeline that would link Turkmen gas fields to India via Afghanistan and Pakistan, though construction has faced repeated delays.

majorChallenges.title: TAPI implementation delays
majorChallenges.description: Regional security conditions, particularly in Afghanistan, have long stalled the pipeline's completion.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
